remarks:
Welcome to the prestigious East Riverside Woods Neighborhood on Grand Island! A charming front porch welcomes you into 2,573 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. This inviting home features hardwood floors, cathedral ceilings, a first-floor office, and a convenient first-floor laundry room.
The spacious first floor offers a living room, dining room, and family room featuring a gas-starter, wood-burning fireplace. An eat-in kitchen with sliding glass doors opens to a large deck overlooking a private, park-like backyard. The fully fenced backyard is a must-see, offering a beautifully landscaped retreat perfect for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying the outdoors. A convenient half bath completes the first floor. Upstairs, you’ll find four spacious bedrooms, including a primary suite with a large walk-in closet and ensuite full bath with separate tub and shower. Enjoy the best of Grand Island living, with easy access to bike trails, state parks, boating, fishing, scenic trails, charming shops, and local dining. Conveniently located near Buffalo, Niagara Falls, and Canada, this exceptional home offers comfort, space, and an ideal location.  Don’t miss this wonderful opportunity—priced to sell!  Open House Wednesday 10/21 (4:30PM-6:30 PM) and Saturday 10/24 (12:00PM-2:00PM).  Offers due Monday 10/26 by 12:00 noon.
